$comment: The protocol version both sides must agree on, plus conformance cases for the `GET /api/v1/version` payload. `protocol_version` is the assertion that matters: server/tests/test_protocol_fixtures.py checks it against fenixspoon.protocol.PROTOCOL_VERSION and the SDK's conformance suite checks it against PROTOCOL_VERSION in @fenix-spoon/client, so bumping one side without the other fails CI on the other. When a second protocol version exists, this file gains a `superseded` list and the corpus can hold cases for both.

valid.name: a later minor on the same major
valid.$comment: Additive, so a 1.0 client must still accept it.

invalid.name: missing protocol
invalid.reason: protocol is required: a payload that cannot say what it speaks is useless

invalid.name: missing api_path
invalid.reason: api_path is required so a client can confirm where this version is served

invalid.name: protocol as a number
invalid.reason: MAJOR.MINOR is a string; 1.10 as a float would compare below 1.9
